incisive.en: Her incisive critique of the model revealed its hidden circularity.
incisive.zh: 她对该模型尖锐的批评揭出了其中隐藏的循环论证。

incisive.en: The paper draws an incisive distinction between adaptation and mitigation.
incisive.zh: 该文在适应与减缓之间作了切中要害的区分。

incisive.en: The interviewer asked incisive questions that exposed inconsistencies in the testimony.
incisive.zh: 访谈者尖锐的提问暴露了证词中的自相矛盾之处。

penetrating.en: The article offers a penetrating analysis of the causes of the crisis.
penetrating.zh: 该文对危机的成因作出了透彻的分析。

penetrating.en: Her penetrating questions revealed what the survey had overlooked.
penetrating.zh: 她敏锐的提问揭示了调查所忽略的部分。

penetrating.en: The penetrating scrutiny of the archive changed the accepted chronology.
penetrating.zh: 对档案的透彻审视改变了公认的年代序列。

scholarly.en: The scholarly debate over this term has run for two centuries.
scholarly.zh: 围绕这一术语的学术论辩已持续两个世纪。

scholarly.en: Her scholarly tradition traces back to a treatise on natural philosophy.
scholarly.zh: 她的学术脉络可追溯到一篇关于自然哲学的论著。

scholarly.en: The journal publishes only scholarly work that has been peer reviewed.
scholarly.zh: 该期刊只发表经过同行评审的学术性成果。

judicious.en: The judicious use of primary sources strengthened the argument considerably.
judicious.zh: 对原始文献的审慎使用显著增强了论证力度。

judicious.en: Judicious editing preserved the manuscript without altering its voice.
judicious.zh: 审慎的编辑保存了这份手稿而未改变其语调。

judicious.en: She made a judicious decision to postpone the survey until the flood receded.
judicious.zh: 她明智地决定把调查推迟到洪水退去之后。

prudent.en: The report offers prudent policy recommendations for coastal managers.
prudent.zh: 该报告为海岸管理者提出了谨慎的政策建议。

prudent.en: Prudent budgeting kept the laboratory solvent through the lean years.
prudent.zh: 谨慎的预算使实验室在拮据年份得以维持收支平衡。

prudent.en: It would be prudent to verify the figures before the article goes to press.
prudent.zh: 在文章付印之前核对这些数字是审慎之举。

astute.en: Her astute reading of the evidence anticipated what later trials confirmed.
astute.zh: 她对证据敏锐的解读预见了后来的试验所证实的结论。

astute.en: The astute negotiator recognized the ambiguity in the offer immediately.
astute.zh: 那位精明的谈判者立刻察觉到报价中的模糊之处。

astute.en: An astute reviewer spotted the flaw in the identification strategy.
astute.zh: 一位敏锐的审稿人发现了识别策略中的缺陷。

apt.en: Epidemiology provides an apt description of how the outbreak spread.
apt.zh: 流行病学为该疫情如何扩散提供了恰当的描述。

apt.en: The author selects an apt term for a concept long recognized in the trade.
apt.zh: 作者为一个早已在该行业中被认识的概念选取了切题的术语。

apt.en: Her metaphor was apt enough to carry the argument a long way.
apt.zh: 她的比喻十分贴切，足以把论证推进很远。

appreciable.en: Rainfall had an appreciable effect on the growth of the seedlings.
appreciable.zh: 降雨对幼苗的生长产生了相当大的影响。

appreciable.en: The reform brought about an appreciable decline in infant mortality.
appreciable.zh: 该改革带来了婴儿死亡率的显著下降。

appreciable.en: Even an appreciable sample size cannot rescue a biased sampling frame.
appreciable.zh: 即使样本量相当可观，也无法挽救一个有偏的抽样框。

landmark.en: The landmark study reshaped how the disease was understood.
landmark.zh: 这项里程碑式的研究重塑了人们对该疾病的理解。

landmark.en: Their landmark discovery opened an entirely new field in chemistry.
landmark.zh: 他们的划时代发现在化学中开启了一个全新的领域。

landmark.en: The court handed down a landmark ruling on the boundary question.
landmark.zh: 法庭就边界问题作出了里程碑式的裁决。

invariably.en: The rule invariably follows from the assumptions set out above.
invariably.zh: 该规则始终如一地由上文所列的假设推出。

invariably.en: Delays invariably followed the arrival of the inspection team.
invariably.zh: 延误总是随着检查组的到来而发生。

invariably.en: Whatever the sampling scheme, the estimate invariably points in the same direction.
invariably.zh: 无论采用何种抽样方案，估计值总是指向同一方向。

narrow.en: The study adopted a narrow focus on a single river basin.
narrow.zh: 该研究采取了仅聚焦于单一流域的狭窄视角。

narrow.en: A narrow scope limits what the survey can claim about the whole region.
narrow.zh: 狭窄的范围限制了调查对整个地区所能作出的论断。

narrow.en: The narrow pass between the ridges funnelled the winter winds.
narrow.zh: 山脊之间的狭窄隘口使冬季的风汇聚成股。

inconsistent.en: The estimate is inconsistent with prior findings from the same laboratory.
inconsistent.zh: 该估计与同一实验室此前的发现不一致。

inconsistent.en: His argument is internally inconsistent and cannot sustain its conclusion.
inconsistent.zh: 他的论证在内部自相矛盾，无法支撑其结论。

inconsistent.en: Inconsistent coding across the two teams inflated the error rate.
inconsistent.zh: 两个团队编码不一致抬高了误差率。

conflict.en: There is a conflict between the theory and the evidence assembled here.
conflict.zh: 理论与此处汇集的证据之间存在冲突。

conflict.en: The conflict between the two dating methods has yet to be resolved.
conflict.zh: 两种定年方法之间的冲突至今尚未解决。

conflict.en: Where the two codes conflict, the more conservative one prevails.
conflict.zh: 在两部法典抵触之处，以较为保守的一部为准。

conflicting.en: Conflicting evidence from the two sites complicates the reconstruction.
conflicting.zh: 来自这两处遗址的相互冲突的证据使重建工作复杂化。

conflicting.en: The witnesses gave conflicting accounts of the same evening.
conflicting.zh: 各位证人对同一晚的情形给出了相互矛盾的陈述。

conflicting.en: Conflicting reports were reconciled by returning to the original logs.
conflicting.zh: 通过回查原始日志，相互冲突的报告得到了调和。

contested.en: The contested concept has been defined in at least four incompatible ways.
contested.zh: 这一有争议的概念至少有四种互不相容的界定。

contested.en: Control of the contested plain passed between two rival administrations.
contested.zh: 这片被争夺的平原的控制权在两个对立的行政当局之间易手。

contested.en: Historians continue to debate the contested origins of the institution.
contested.zh: 历史学家仍在争论该机构那颇受争议的起源。

disputed.en: The disputed findings were reanalyzed before appearing in the review.
disputed.zh: 这些有争议的结论在进入综述之前被重新分析。

disputed.en: The boundary remains disputed among three neighboring provinces.
disputed.zh: 这条边界在相邻的三个省之间仍存争议。

disputed.en: A disputed estimate of population size biases the whole reconstruction.
disputed.zh: 一个有争议的人口规模估计会使整个重建产生偏倚。

contentious.en: The proposal met with a contentious reception at the public hearing.
contentious.zh: 该提案在公开听证会上引起了充满争议的反响。

contentious.en: Genetic modification remains a contentious topic in the curriculum debate.
contentious.zh: 基因改造在课程论辩中仍是一个易引起争执的话题。

contentious.en: The committee deferred the contentious issue of funding to a later session.
contentious.zh: 委员会把经费这一有争议的问题推迟到后续会议处理。

inconclusive.en: The results were inconclusive and did not settle the question.
inconclusive.zh: 结果并不确定，未能就此问题作出定论。

inconclusive.en: The trial stopped early because the interim analysis proved inconclusive.
inconclusive.zh: 由于中期分析证明无定论，试验提前终止。

inconclusive.en: Inconclusive evidence about the mechanism keeps the model under debate.
inconclusive.zh: 关于该机制的证据不确定，使该模型持续处于争论之中。

indirect.en: The program had an indirect effect on prices in adjacent markets.
indirect.zh: 该项目对邻近市场的价格产生了间接影响。

indirect.en: Indirect evidence from the archive supports the later chronology.
indirect.zh: 来自档案的间接证据支持了较晚的年代序列。

indirect.en: The link between the two variables is indirect but consistent.
indirect.zh: 两个变量之间的联系是间接的，但保持一致。

unbiased.en: Random sampling yields an unbiased estimator of the population mean.
unbiased.zh: 随机抽样给出一个关于总体均值的无偏估计量。

unbiased.en: The reviewers stayed unbiased by declining invitations from both camps.
unbiased.zh: 审稿人拒绝了来自双方的邀请，从而保持了不偏不倚。

unbiased.en: An unbiased assessment requires that the raters remain blind to the source.
unbiased.zh: 无偏的评估要求评分者对来源保持盲态。

nontrivial.en: The treatment had a nontrivial effect on recovery time.
nontrivial.zh: 该治疗对恢复时间产生了显著的影响。

nontrivial.en: Establishing a nontrivial causal link requires a longitudinal design.
nontrivial.zh: 确立一条实质性的因果联系需要纵向研究设计。

nontrivial.en: The difference between the two estimators is nontrivial in small samples.
nontrivial.zh: 两个估计量之间的差异在小样本中不可忽略。

desirable.en: Stability is a desirable property of any long-term estimator.
desirable.zh: 稳定性是任何长期估计量都合乎需要的性质。

desirable.en: It is desirable to replicate the analysis with a second instrument.
desirable.zh: 用第二种测量工具重复该分析是值得期望的。

desirable.en: The authors identify several desirable trends in the regional record.
desirable.zh: 作者辨认出区域记录中的若干可取趋势。
